Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
Scene:
  identity: compact, unfinished concrete town; stark cold-blue battleground
  platform: broad, roughly square, polygonal platform
  surroundings: platform surrounded by an apparently endless field of rough, rippled rocky terrain
  ground cover: all ground covered in coarse, uneven gravel-like material
District:
  buildings: several dozen pale gray and blue-white masonry structures
  arrangement: irregular cluster forming broken sightlines rather than a regular grid
  center: cramped and maze-like, with densest buildings around the central compound
  central compound: damaged, debris-filled, exposed framework, a few warm points of light
  outward transition: increasingly sparse toward platform edges
  outer buildings: generous empty ground around outer buildings; uneven transition from dense urban cluster to exposed boundary
  circulation: broad open yards, winding street-like gaps between tighter inner blocks
  absent: marked roads, pavements, vegetation, vehicles, people
Buildings:
  massing: mostly boxy, flat-roofed
  height: one to four stories
  variation: footprints and heights
  upper walls: weathered plaster
  brickwork: darker blue-gray around lower floors and occasional upper bands
  parapets: shallow
  windows: barred rectangles
  entrances: rusty boarded or metal door openings
  equipment: scattered wall-mounted air-conditioning units
  balconies: a few narrow projections
  roof divisions: many roofs divided into simple rectangular panels
Concrete towers:
  quantity: numerous
  form: tall, slender, rectangular
  distribution: among the buildings, beside open spaces, along the perimeter, and scattered beyond the platform across the surrounding terrain
  variations: some tiny square openings; others ending in dark vertical slotted caps
Lighting:
  sun: low, harsh
  shadows: very long, cool cyan shade
  highlights: bright, washed
  sky: pale, hazy
